name: DentiSystems - High Severity Honeypot Breach Detected

properties.displayName: DentiSystems - High Severity Honeypot Breach Detected
properties.description: Identifies critical exploitation attempts, unauthorized shell breakouts, or high-severity attacks intercepted by DentiGrid active deception honeypot sensors.
properties.query:
DENTIGRIDThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where toint(Severity_d) >= 8 or toint(Severity_s) >= 8 or Signature_s has_any ('RCE', 'Exploit', 'Breakout', 'Rootkit', 'Unauthorized Access', 'Privilege Escalation')
| extend IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP_s, tostring(column_ifexists('ip_s', '')))
| extend HostCustomEntity = coalesce(NodeID_s, tostring(column_ifexists('node_id_s', '')))
| extend ProtocolCustom = coalesce(Protocol_s, tostring(column_ifexists('protocol_s', '')))
| extend PortCustom = coalesce(tostring(DestinationPort_d), tostring(column_ifexists('port_d', '')))
| project TimeGenerated, IPCustomEntity, HostCustomEntity, ProtocolCustom, PortCustom, Signature_s, Severity_s, SourceCountry_s, SourceCity_s, URL_s, Platform_s
